title: Scene brief
description: What the Scene Brief form stores in briefs/{id} (schema 2), and what the manager writes to projects/<slug>/brief.yaml. Schema 1 briefs had name, deadline and destination; destination maps to route.

title.description: First line of the project or context text; shown in the brief list

route.description: Where the scene is built. blender_unreal: modelled and assembled in Blender, exported to Unreal for lighting. blender: CG, Blender only.

fidelity.description: faithful: hero pieces and variants, not the fewest pieces (house rule 6). inspired: keeps the look, free on piece counts. replica is the form's older value and is treated as faithful.

light_refs.description: A path or link per line

gen_tripo.description: v6. Tripo for detailed props (the tripo-props skill). Used only when detail is detailed or final; the credit question at G0 comes first

gen_magnific_3d.description: v6. Magnific 3D generation, under the same rule as gen_tripo

project_prompt.description: What it is, game or CG, and where it is built, in your own words

id.description: Asset id in the form artifact's asset store, served at /_blob/<id>

context_prompt.description: Context, place, era, fidelity, mood, must-haves and must-avoids in your own words

id.description: Asset id in the form artifact's asset store, served at /_blob/<id>

lighting_prompt.description: Time of day, weather, key light and practicals in your own words

id.description: Asset id in the form artifact's asset store, served at /_blob/<id>

parallel_modelers.description: v5. Modelers that work at once in the asset lane after gate K

parallel_asset_tech.description: v5. Asset Techs that work at once

generation_services.description: Order in which generation services are tried; Tripo first when gen_tripo is on

work_dir.description: v5. Folder outside git for .blend and FBX files and reference photos; default PipelineWork/<slug> next to the Unreal project

mode.description: v6. blockout: light and colour follow the reference's mood once the modelling is done (neutral until then). camera_match: the same, matched to a photo's camera, with landmark fit checks. full_cg: a finished CG scene with measured light and real-world values. Set by the user's prompt; the interview asks if missing.

tier.description: v6. Set by the user in the prompt (ask at G0 if missing). Sets research depth, reviews and gates: see scene-pipeline.

autopilot.description: v6. On only when the prompt asks. Gates are posted for the record and the defaults taken without waiting; the manager still stops for credits beyond the budget, deletions, and scope or route changes.

detail.description: Defined once in scene-pipeline. massing: volumes at real scale on the kit grid, no small parts, no inventory, generation off. detailed: every feature the references show, built from plan/inventory.yaml. final: detailed plus finished assets from the asset lane. full_cg defaults to final.

standing_rules.description: Per-project rules from the user, in their words. The manager quotes the list into every lane brief and reviewer prompt.

lighting_focus.description: deferred freezes colour, contrast and light (rig and exposure stay as they are, reviewers skip light) until the user sends lighting references. Empty: light follows house rule 7.

light_depth.description: How far the lighting brief goes, asked in the interview's process round. Read by lighting-brief. The default is mood, except measured in full_cg.

starting_point.description: from scratch, or the earlier file to reuse with the parts allowed (kit, layout, props)

gate_pacing.description: default_path: start the reversible default while a gate waits, never past the gate. wait: start nothing until the answer. Autopilot is the separate autopilot key.

review_scope.description: visible: only what the walk paths and review cameras see (visible_set.json). whole_scene: everything.

concept_model.description: Model for concept images, made with the user's references and only after the credit question is answered

generation_preapproved.description: Asked once in the interview: the browser with Tripo signed in, GLB downloads into the work folder, headless Blender. Credits are a separate question.

walk.description: Walkable scenes: constraints that size the layout before any map is drawn

walk_time_min.description: Minutes to walk the scene end to end

footprint_m.description: Width x depth in metres, e.g. 30 x 12

board_url.description: The Gate Review Board artifact. Published before G0 if empty (gate-board).

budgets.description: v6. Asked at G0, never assumed. A missing key or null means no cap.

cables.description: v6. rig: finished cables from the cable generator in the toolbox, each run ending at a real object or past the frame edge. guides: one curve per run with marked end points, for the user's own cable tool.

knowledge_local.description: v6. Private solved-problems folder outside git (notes with photos or client details). Default: knowledge/ in the work root, next to the project work_dirs.

fields.description: Either the quick-option fields or the section's prompt and images can be filled. At least one of project_prompt, context_prompt, context or context_images is needed to submit.
